units.literal: The memorial entered and received a favorable edict in reply.

units.zh: 五月，卒，贈太子少保，諡文敬。
units.en: He died in the fifth month and was posthumously made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the title Wenjing (Cultivated Respect).
units.literal: In the fifth month he died; posthumously granted Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; posthumous title Wenjing.

units.zh: 士驤少孤露，起家幕僚，至於專閫，與人無迕，眾皆稱其通敏雲。
units.en: Orphaned young, Yang rose from secretarial work to frontier command, offended no one, and was widely praised for his tact and quick wit.
units.literal: Shixiang in youth was orphaned and exposed, rose from staff service to frontier command, had no conflict with others—all praised his versatile quickness, it is said.

units.zh: 馮煦，字夢華，江蘇金壇人。
units.en: Feng Xu, whose courtesy name was Menghua, came from Jintan in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Feng Xu, courtesy name Menghua, was a native of Jintan, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 光緒十二年一甲三名進士，授編修。
units.en: In 1886 he placed among the top three metropolitan graduates of the first class and was appointed Hanlin compiler.
units.literal: In the twelfth year of Guangxu he was metropolitan graduate of the first class, top three, and appointed Hanlin compiler.

units.zh: 疊上疏代奏，請圖自強，敦大本，行實政，德宗嘉納。
units.en: He repeatedly memorialized for national self-strengthening, sound fundamentals, and practical government; Emperor Guangxu approved.
units.literal: Repeatedly he submitted memorials for presentation, requesting plans for self-strengthening, honoring the great foundation, and carrying out practical government—Emperor Dezong commended and accepted.

units.zh: 典湖南鄉試，稱得士。
units.en: As chief examiner of the Hunan provincial examinations, he was praised for selecting able candidates.
units.literal: He presided over the Hunan provincial examination and was said to have obtained worthy scholars.

units.zh: 二十一年，以京察一等授安徽鳳陽知府。
units.en: In 1895, rated first class in the metropolitan personnel review, he was appointed prefect of Fengyang in Anhui.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year, through metropolitan personnel review of the first grade he was appointed Fengyang prefect of Anhui.

units.zh: 鳳屬連年水澇，煦單騎按部，逐一履勘，以被災之重輕，定給賑之多寡，人霑實惠。
units.en: Fengyang suffered floods year after year; Feng rode alone through the district, inspected each area, and scaled relief to the severity of damage so that people received real help.
units.literal: Fengyang territory suffered flood and waterlogging year after year; Xu rode alone on inspection, examined each place in turn, and according to the severity of disaster fixed the amount of relief—people received real benefit.

units.zh: 並屢平反疑獄。
units.en: He also repeatedly overturned wrongful convictions in doubtful cases.
units.literal: He also repeatedly reversed doubtful cases.

units.zh: 總督劉坤一以心存利濟、政切先勞疏保，兩攝鳳潁六泗道。
units.en: Governor-General Liu Kunyi recommended him for devoted public service and twice had him act as intendant of the Fengying-Liusi Circuit.
units.literal: Governor-General Liu Kunyi memorialized to recommend him for mind set on benefiting others and government earnest in taking hardship first; twice he acted as Fengying-Liusi Circuit intendant.

units.zh: 二十七年，遷山西按察使，調四川。
units.en: In 1901 he was transferred to judicial commissioner of Shanxi, then to Sichuan.
units.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was transferred to Shanxi judicial commissioner, then to Sichuan.

units.zh: 廣安州有聚眾謀毀學堂者，獲四人，擬照土匪例正法。
units.en: At Guang'an Prefecture a crowd plotted to destroy a school; four were arrested and the provincial government proposed executing them under the bandit law.
units.literal: In Guang'an Prefecture men gathered plotting to destroy a school; four were seized and it was proposed to execute them by the bandit precedent.

units.zh: 煦白大府，請按而後誅，以去就爭，至免冠抵幾，不得請不止。
units.en: Feng appealed to the provincial government for trial before execution, staking his office on the point, even removing his cap and pounding the desk until his request was granted.
units.literal: Xu informed the superior office, requesting trial before execution; he contested with his post at stake, even removing his cap and striking the desk—he would not stop until his request was granted.

units.zh: 旋署布政使，復調安徽，兼署提學使。
units.en: He soon served as acting provincial treasurer, returned to Anhui, and also acted as education commissioner.
units.literal: Shortly he acted as provincial treasurer, again transferred to Anhui, concurrently acting as education commissioner.

units.zh: 三十三年，擢巡撫。
units.en: In 1907 he was promoted governor.
units.literal: In the thirty-third year he was promoted governor.

units.zh: 時國是日非，海內外黨人昌言革命。
units.en: National affairs were deteriorating daily, and revolutionaries at home and abroad openly preached revolution.
units.literal: At the time national affairs daily worsened; revolutionaries at home and abroad loudly proclaimed revolution.

units.zh: 巡撫恩銘被刺，眾情惶惑。
units.en: Governor En Ming was assassinated, and the public was shaken.
units.literal: Governor En Ming was assassinated and popular sentiment was fearful and unsettled.

units.zh: 煦繼任，處以鎮靜，治其獄，不株連一人，主散脅從，示寬大，人心始安。
units.en: Feng succeeded him, acted calmly, tried the case without implicating others, urged leniency toward followers, and gradually restored public confidence.
units.literal: Xu succeeded to office, handled matters with calm, tried the case, implicated not a single other person, advocated dispersing followers, showed leniency—popular hearts only then settled.

units.zh: 复疏言：「今者黨禍已亟，民生不聊。
units.en: He memorialized again: "Party strife has become acute and the people's livelihood is desperate.
units.literal: Again he memorialized: 'Now party calamity is already urgent, and popular livelihood has no relief.

units.zh: 中外大臣不思引咎自責，合力圖強，乃粉飾因循，苟安旦夕，貽誤將來，大局阽危，日甚一日。
units.en: Ministers at court and abroad neither accept blame nor unite to strengthen the state; they paper over problems, cling to routine, and seek a day's peace while the empire grows more perilous by the day.
units.literal: Chinese and foreign ministers do not think to accept blame and reproach themselves, join strength to seek vigor—instead they ornament and cover, follow old ways, seek peace for a day and night, entrust error to the future; the great situation teeters on peril, worse day by day.

units.zh: 挽救之方，唯以覈名實、明賞罰為第一義，而其要則在'民為邦本'一言。
units.en: Salvation lies first in matching names to realities and enforcing clear rewards and punishments—and above all in the principle that the people are the foundation of the state.
units.literal: The method of rescue lies solely in verifying name and reality and clarifying rewards and punishments as the first principle—and its key lies in the one phrase 'the people are the foundation of the state.'

units.zh: 有尊主庇民之臣，用之勿疑；
units.en: Employ without hesitation ministers who honor the throne and protect the people;
units.literal: Where there are ministers who honor the ruler and shelter the people, employ them without doubt;

units.zh: 有誤國殃民之臣，刑之毋赦。
units.en: and punish without mercy those who harm the state and injure the people.
units.literal: where there are ministers who harm the state and bring calamity on the people, punish them without pardon.

units.zh: 政府能使天下自治，則天下莫能亂；
units.en: If the government can make the realm govern itself, no one can throw it into chaos;
units.literal: If government can make the realm self-govern, then the realm cannot be thrown into disorder;

units.zh: 政府能使天下舉安，則天下莫能危。
units.en: if it can make the realm secure as a whole, no one can endanger it.
units.literal: if government can make the realm all secure, then the realm cannot be endangered.

units.zh: 根本大計，實係於此。」
units.en: The fundamental policy truly rests on this."
units.literal: The fundamental great plan truly hinges on this.'

units.zh: 疏入，大臣權幸多忌嫉之。
units.en: The memorial angered many powerful courtiers.
units.literal: The memorial entered; powerful favored ministers mostly envied and resented him.

units.zh: 明年，遂罷。
units.en: The following year he was dismissed.
units.literal: The next year he was dismissed.

units.zh: 宣統二年，江、皖大水，復起為查賑大臣，出入災區，規定辦法，施及豫東，未一年，凡賑三十九州縣，放款至三百馀萬。
units.en: In 1910, after great floods in Jiangsu and Anhui, he was again appointed relief commissioner, traveled through the disaster areas, set procedures, and extended aid into eastern Henan; within a year he relieved thirty-nine prefectures and counties and disbursed more than three million taels in loans.
units.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Jiang and Wan suffered great floods; he was again raised as relief-inspection minister, went in and out of disaster zones, fixed methods, extended to eastern Henan—in less than a year he relieved thirty-nine prefectures and counties, disbursing loans to more than three million.

units.zh: 後復立義賑會。
units.en: He later founded a charitable relief society as well.
units.literal: Later he again established a charitable relief society.

units.zh: 連年水旱，兼有兵災，遠而推至京、直、魯、豫、湘、浙，無歲不災，無災不賑，蓋自蒞官訖致仕，逮於耄老，與荒政相終始，眾稱善人。
units.en: Floods, droughts, and wars followed one another from the capital through Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Hunan, and Zhejiang; scarcely a year passed without disaster or relief work. From his first office to retirement and old age, famine relief was the thread of his career, and he was widely called a good man.
units.literal: Year after year flood and drought, together with military calamity—extending far to Beijing, Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Hunan, Zhejiang—no year without disaster, no disaster without relief; from taking office until retirement, down to great old age, he was with famine administration from start to finish; all called him a good man.

units.zh: 聞國變，痛哭失聲。
units.en: When he heard of the dynastic collapse, he wept until he could not speak.
units.literal: On hearing the national transformation, he wept bitterly and lost his voice.

units.zh: 越十有五年，卒，年八十五。
units.en: Fifteen years later he died at eighty-five.
units.literal: Fifteen years later he died at age eighty-five.

units.zh: 煦居官廉而好施。
units.en: Feng was incorrupt in office and generous in charity.
units.literal: In office Xu was incorrupt and fond of giving.

units.zh: 平素講學，以有恥為的，重躬行實踐。
units.en: He lectured on learning, taking moral shame as his aim and stressing practice over theory.
units.literal: In ordinary times he lectured on learning, taking having shame as the target, emphasizing personal practice and real conduct.

units.zh: 文章爾雅，晚境至鬻文自給雲。
units.en: His prose was refined; in his last years he is said to have supported himself by selling his writing.
units.literal: His writings were refined and elegant; in late years he even sold essays to support himself, it is said.

units.zh: 論曰：光緒初，督撫權重，及其末年，中央集權，復多設法令以牽制之，吏治不可言矣。
units.en: The historian comments: Early in the Guangxu reign governors held great power; by its end the court centralized authority and multiplied regulations to restrain them—administration was beyond repair.
units.literal: The critique states: Early in Guangxu, governors-general and governors held heavy power; by its last years central power was concentrated, and moreover many laws and orders were set up to restrain them—civil administration cannot be spoken of.

units.zh: 錫良強直負重，安內攘外，頗有建樹。
units.en: Xi Liang was upright and bore heavy responsibilities, pacifying internal troubles and resisting foreign pressure, with notable achievements.
units.literal: Xi Liang was strong and upright, bore heavy responsibility, pacified within and repelled without—he had considerable achievements.

units.zh: 馥諳練，士驤通敏，元鼎辦交涉，曾敭論法律，並能持正。
units.en: Zhou Fu was experienced, Yang Shixiang tactful, Lu Yuanding handled foreign affairs, and Zhang Cengyang debated law—all upheld integrity.
units.literal: Fu was practiced and skilled, Shixiang versatile and quick, Yuanding handled negotiations, Cengyang discoursed on law—all able to hold to rectitude.

units.zh: 煦善治賑，與荒政相終始。
units.en: Feng excelled at famine relief throughout his career.
units.literal: Xu was good at managing relief and was with famine administration from start to finish.

units.zh: 「民為邦本」，善哉言乎！
units.en: "The people are the foundation of the state"—well said indeed!
units.literal: 'The people are the foundation of the state'—excellent words indeed!

units.zh: 錫良初疏諫集權，樞廷轉相箝制。
units.en: Xi Liang had early warned against centralization, yet the Grand Council obstructed him in turn.
units.literal: Xi Liang at first memorialized remonstrating against centralization; the Grand Council in turn mutually obstructed him.

units.zh: 及事變起，大勢所趨，皆一如所言，世尤服其先見雲。
units.en: When crisis came, events unfolded just as he had warned, and the world especially admired his foresight.
units.literal: When incidents arose, the trend of the great situation all matched what he had said—the age especially admired his foresight, it is said.
